name: Fist Pearl of Tuyết Lộc (Tuyết Lộc Quyền Châu)
lore: The pearl the size of a fist that a Tuyết Lộc fisher pulled from Hạo Nguyệt Hồ in 470 and sold to the manor, which began to farm pearls because of it (A007). Seven hundred years of mistresses have laid their own nacre over it, and it is now the size of a child's head and as heavy as a stone seal. Kiều Nguyệt Châu throws it like one.
build_use: The mistress's weapon: Water damage and a last ward when the long fight turns against her.
made_by: the lake (A007); re-nacred by each mistress
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Moon-Fish Lantern (Nguyệt Ngư Đăng)
lore: A lantern of oyster shell ground thin as paper, hung over the pool on moonless nights so the spirit fish think the moon is still on the water. It was made after the freeze of 748, when the fish lived through a winter on the moon's reflection alone (C146) and the manor learned they would die without it. Mục Tiềm Uyên has lit it every dark night for a hundred and fifty years.
build_use: The pool-keeper's sustain: healing and linh lực for a fight he means to outlast.

name: Nacre Robe of Trầm Bích (Trầm Bích Trân Bào)
lore: A robe of lake silk sewn with a thousand flakes of nacre from the oyster beds, worn by each mistress at the moon rite on the stilt-halls. In moonlight it is hard to tell from the pool.
build_use: Linh lực and a cheaper ward: she lets the other side spend first.

name: Frost-Lotus Pin of Kiều Băng Liên (Băng Liên Trâm)
lore: The hairpin her grandmother wore the winter of 748, when she sat on the frozen pool and kept the spirit fish alive. Frost forms on it in summer.
build_use: The thread of Ice in her root, made to last.
